# Shastriya Vidhan

> Puja booking and preparation information, with Pandit Ji availability, ritual scope, samagri arrangements and quotes confirmed before booking.

Shastriya Vidhan helps families request Hindu puja services at home, at suitable venues, at temples where reviewed, or online when the ritual can be guided remotely. A submitted enquiry is not a confirmed booking until the team checks the ceremony, date, locality, Pandit Ji availability, samagri responsibility, quote, and booking terms.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/) - Brand overview and request-first puja booking.
- [Puja Services](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/puja-services) - Public directory of active puja service pages.
- [Pandit Ji in Noida](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/locations/noida) - Local Noida booking page for puja enquiries at home, office, shop, society venues, and suitable online requests.
- [Service Locations](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/locations) - Public locations hub with live city pages and enquiry-first service areas.
- [Puja at Home](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/puja-at-home) - Home puja request mode and preparation notes.
- [Online Puja](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/online-puja) - Live video guidance where the ritual is suitable for remote participation.

## Selected puja services

- [Rudrabhishek Puja in Noida](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/book-pandit-ji-for-rudrabhishek-puja-noida) - Shiva abhishek booking request with samagri and mode review.
- [Shrimad Bhagwat Katha](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/shrimad-bhagwat-katha) - Katha planning for home, temple, venue, community, and Delhi NCR enquiries after scope review.
- [Mahamrityunjaya Jaap Puja](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/book-pandit-ji-online-for-mahamrityunjaya-jaap-puja) - Jaap and puja request page with scope, duration, and samagri confirmation.
- [Diwali Lakshmi Ganesh Puja](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/book-pandit-ji-online-for-diwali-puja) - Festival puja request page with date, slot, samagri, and quote review.
- [Krishna Janmashtami Puja](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/book-pandit-ji-online-for-janmashtami-puja) - Janmashtami puja planning with timing and participation review.
- [Hanuman Chalisa Path](https://www.shastriyavidhan.com/book-pandit-ji-for-hanuman-chalisa-path) - Path request page with mode, samagri, and location suitability review.
